info.name: Reni Social API — Accurate Examples
info.description: Generated from the supplied Reni Social Go codebase and its API_DOCUMENTATION.md. Examples reflect documented handler behavior, including mixed JSON casing and raw post-handler responses.

request.description: Step 1: sends an email verification code through Reni Central.

originalRequest.description: Step 1: sends an email verification code through Reni Central.

request.description: Step 2: verifies the emailed code.

originalRequest.description: Step 2: verifies the emailed code.

request.description: Step 3: completes registration. On success data.token is replaced with the local Redis session id.

originalRequest.description: Step 3: completes registration. On success data.token is replaced with the local Redis session id.

request.description: Signs in through Reni Central, upserts the local user and creates a local Redis session. Save data.token as X-Session-Id.

originalRequest.description: Signs in through Reni Central, upserts the local user and creates a local Redis session. Save data.token as X-Session-Id.

request.description: Deletes the session associated with the bearer token.

originalRequest.description: Deletes the session associated with the bearer token.

request.description: Returns the local user. The handler only selects id, email, first_name, last_name, avatar_url and created_at; other fields are zero values.

originalRequest.description: Returns the local user. The handler only selects id, email, first_name, last_name, avatar_url and created_at; other fields are zero values.

request.description: Creates a workspace; caller becomes owner.

originalRequest.description: Creates a workspace; caller becomes owner.

request.description: Caller must be admin/owner. Valid request roles are empty/member/admin/owner, but owner is downgraded to member by the service.

originalRequest.description: Caller must be admin/owner. Valid request roles are empty/member/admin/owner, but owner is downgraded to member by the service.

request.description: Owner cannot be removed.

originalRequest.description: Owner cannot be removed.

request.description: Creates a draft or scheduled post. Platforms: linkedin, meta_ig, meta_fb, x, tiktok. scheduled_at=null creates a draft; a future ISO-8601 value creates scheduled status. article_url is rejected with meta_ig/tiktok.

response.name: 201 Example

originalRequest.description: Creates a draft or scheduled post. Platforms: linkedin, meta_ig, meta_fb, x, tiktok. scheduled_at=null creates a draft; a future ISO-8601 value creates scheduled status. article_url is rejected with meta_ig/tiktok.

    "UpdatedAt": "2026-08-07T10:00:00Z",
